description:
List available trading signals: names, types (TRIGGER or FILTER) and short descriptions. Use it to browse the catalogue, or narrow it by regime band, role or library category.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

category.description: Filter by category (momentum, trend, volume, volatility, patterns, onchain)

limit.description: Page size: default 30, maximum 30. Larger requests are capped; use next_offset to continue.

regime_direction.description: Filter to signals admissible for a regime band (mega_bull, super_bull, bull, neutral, bear, super_bear, mega_bear)

role.description: Filter by the part a signal plays in a strategy (TRIGGER or FILTER)

name: list_signals
